input.summary: Extend IBM's indemnity beyond IP to breach of law, IBM-caused data breach and wilful misconduct/gross negligence, and narrow Customer's Services Recipient indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] IBM's indemnity currently covers only IP infringement, so we added the standard heads for IBM's breach of law, IBM-caused unauthorised access to our data, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, and we narrowed our own indemnity so we do not underwrite third-party claims arising from IBM's own Services. If helpful, we can accept the additional IBM heads being subject to a super-cap of 3x annual charges.

ops.text: In addition to the foregoing, IBM will defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer, its Enterprise and their respective employees, officers, agents and directors from and against any third party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) IBM's breach of applicable law; (ii) any unauthorised access to, or use or disclosure of, Customer's Content or other Customer data caused by IBM, its Affiliates or Subcontractors; or (iii) IBM's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The notice, control and cooperation provisions of Subsections 8.1(a) and 8.1(b) apply to claims under this paragraph, and the exclusions and remedies limitations set out above (including the statement that Section 8.1 is IBM's entire obligation) apply only to claims of infringement.

ops.oldText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and is related, directly or indirectly, to the Services; or
ops.newText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and arises out of Customer's breach of applicable law or Customer's breach of this Agreement; or
